caseName: Gould v. Hyde Park Water Co.
caseNameFull: Harriet H. Gould and Frederick A. Waldron v. Hyde Park Water Company, First National Bank of Boston, and City of Boston
summary: Appeal from the District Court of the United States for the District of Massachusetts.
attorneys: Mr. Roscoe Walsworth and Mr. Frederick S. Deitrick for appellants., Mr. Robert M. Morse, Mr. Wm. M. Richardson and Mr. Edward E. Blodgett for appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of Deming v. Carlisle Packing Co., 226 U. S. 102, 105; Consolidated Turnpike Co. v. Norfolk &c. Ry. Co., 228 U. S. 596, 600; Stewart v. Kansas City, 239 U. S. 14.
